📖 How to use

  1. Enter buy price, sell price and quantity.
  2. Pick short-term or long-term holding and enter the applicable tax rate.
  3. Read your gain, estimated tax and net proceeds.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Short-term vs long-term gains?

Assets held one year or less are usually taxed as short-term gains (ordinary rates); longer holdings qualify as long-term gains at a different rate. This tool lets you enter the applicable rate for either case.

How is the tax computed?

Gain = (sell price − buy price) × quantity. Tax owed = gain × your tax rate, applied only when the gain is positive.

What if I sold at a loss?

A loss produces no tax in this estimate — the loss amount is shown so you can discuss tax-loss harvesting with a professional.
